LProgramStart.trigger: The program starts and Wails invokes the backend startup lifecycle.
LProgramStart.notes: Startup-specific subchains should not be reused for user-triggered build or preparation actions. Shared logic should keep a normal L-object name.

PPrepClick.trigger: The user approves the toolchain preparation plan from the UI.
PPrepClick.notes: The approval chain validates the review session, asks native approval if needed, consumes the session, then starts the toolchain action.

PBuildClick.trigger: The user approves the FFmpeg build plan from the UI.
PBuildClick.notes: The approval chain validates the review session, asks native approval if needed, consumes the session, then starts the FFmpeg build action.

PSourceSelect.trigger: The user selects a workspace or FFmpeg source release from the Source tab.
PSourceSelect.notes: Source-tab selection can refresh library catalog compatibility without becoming a build action.
